amendment_A1: pre-results amendment after the independent plan review (no run output existed): enforced freeze (plan verified by run, label and evaluate; decoder CLI, truth-file and registry digests pinned), control policy aligned to the SEG-077 Lua (emulated frame k receives policy(k-1); frame 1 none), Gate A expected zone order and end state, read self-fetch and vblank-execution checks, control fidelity in tracing_ok, an append-only CPU ledger, extra cells exclude cells the control labelled wrongly, a second control seed as a sensitivity report, DATA_ONLY_PROMISE listed as a secondary label
amendment_A2: pre-results tool fix: movie.* Lua calls are only called in the movie and playback modes (they raise a .NET exception that pcall cannot catch when no movie is loaded)
amendment_A3: pre-results: the CPU ledger is <private>/ledger.jsonl with intent+completion lines, evaluate requires a successful attempt per expected step and charges an unfinished attempt its wall time; control Gate A requires the vblank PC executed
amendment_A4: pre-results (operator request): BizHawk's native Code/Data Logger is started from Lua (client.gettool('cdl').Restart(), no BizHawk change) and its MD CART log is read by reflection at the end of each run. A synthetic DMA fixture (`cdl-fixture`) must reproduce, exactly, the executed PCs, the DMASource extent (0x40), and the data-read extents (0x04, true access size); exec flags must agree with the callback PCs within 0.1% of bytes; both are Gate A tracing conditions. DMA-source extents come from CDL flag 0x40 and a callback read byte is admitted as data only where the CDL logged a data access (instruction fetch and prefetch are never CDL data). Both conditions use the identical tiers. Reset/state-load behaviour is not exercised (power-on movie, random control, no loads). Batch-1 traces (A3, no CDL) were produced and their aggregate PC counts were seen before this amendment; they are superseded, archived and reported, the thresholds and decision logic are unchanged. If the DMA tier cannot be assessed the mixed-cell metric is NOT_EVALUABLE rather than a code-yield failure.

control.label_inputs: tas = trace run A only; control = seed-1 run A only; repeats serve only the determinism checks
control.policy: SEG-077 `random` policy (segarecomp_genesis_evidence.LUA): emulated frame k receives policy(k-1), frame 1 none
control.sync: BizHawk default GPGX sync settings (the movie run uses the movie's); decision is conditional on seed 1, the seed-2 control is reported as sensitivity only

disclosure: Sonic 2 was used in SEG-072 and in SEG-077 rule selection: a controlled known-truth engineering test, not blind
emulator: BizHawk 2.9.1 official linux-x64 package under Mono; the movie header names version 2.9.1 and core Genplus-gx
evaluator_isolation: the source-truth classes of `s2` are read only by `evaluate`; `run` and `label` never open them

gate_a.expected_end_state: final game mode 0x20 (ending sequence) or (game mode 0x0C and zone 0x0E) at the last movie frame
gate_a.level_mode: (Game_Mode & 0x7F) == 0x0C; special stage 0x10; a checkpoint in any other mode (title, menu, continue) is a stall
needs: movie plays to its end in the original emulator
five frozen checkpoints show actual progression (>= 2 different zone/act values, game mode in-level at >= 2)
trace repeat: identical PC-set digest, read-set digest and checkpoint state digests
trace fidelity: ROM mapping mismatch 0; every PC even; accepted-E fraction of executed ROM PCs >= 0.99; execute callbacks seen at the reset-vector PC and the vblank-vector PC
the same fidelity and determinism checks for the control runs
gate_a.progression: all five checkpoints in level or special-stage mode; >= 2 level-mode checkpoints; their zones, in checkpoint order, form a non-decreasing subsequence of zone_play_order with >= 2 distinct zones

subjects: TAS labels absent (same class) from the control labels

gate_b_vacuity: a class with zero labels passes vacuously; counts are reported

gate_c.correct: every I/c/D label inside the cell agrees with the independent source truth
gate_c.extra: cell index satisfying the predicate with correct TAS labels, neither satisfying it in the control labels nor containing a wrong control label
gate_c.nontrivial_negative: a fully-D 128-byte cell whose bytes are not all one repeated value
gate_c.threshold_rationale: operator-fixed engineering feasibility thresholds (materially above the Chuck Rock TAS yield)

emulator.mono: Mono JIT compiler version 6.8.0.105 (Debian 6.8.0.105+dfsg-3.6ubuntu2 Sun Mar 31 02:55:28 UTC 2024)

movie: tasvideos 5640M, BizHawk 2.9.1 .bk2, core Genplus-gx, 2-player (6-button sync setting), starts from power-on
novelty: descriptive only (no threshold): 4-gram of (family, ea_src, ea_dst, width, control) signatures over consecutive labelled starts, and 3-cell class-pattern windows, against every SEG-072 registry image except Sonic 2
precedence: BUDGET_EXHAUSTED is reported first when the CPU ledger exceeds the cap (the experiment could not be completed within the cap)
tiers: SEG-077 `label()` unchanged; DMA-source tier from the BizHawk CDL (both conditions); DR reads: callback bytes gated by CDL data flags
